authoritative_external_protocol.addendum: v0.7.1A Functional Mapping and Natural Limit-Testbed Addendum
authoritative_external_protocol.authority_rule: Truth outranks continuity, including the continuity of the program itself.

permits: diagnostic calculations after a preserved qualification failure
mapping where a representation works and where it degrades
use of already observed results for discovery only
forbids: relabeling exploratory evidence as untouched confirmation
retroactively changing a failed frozen gate into PASS

permits: using qualification failures to design a successor System Model or Engine version
reusing the same qualification evidence to test and improve candidate implementation logic
versioned successor protocols after a preserved HOLD
requires: preserve prior failures as historical facts
record why each successor version changed
do not present qualification-informed evidence as untouched P1 confirmation
keep thresholds and evidence firewalls unchanged unless a separately justified scientific amendment is frozen before new decisive evidence
claim-specific frozen assumptions and acceptance rules
MFR-14 floor where a confirmatory or predictive claim is made
evidence not used to learn the tested rule or threshold
prospective validation appropriate to the claim

H_Ru0001_post_hold_K20_K24_K28.purpose: Identify the dense-k numerical region after the preserved K16-to-K20 coupled failure without rewriting that failure.

claim_specific_stopping_rule.principle: A component may be closed when the evidence required for its stated claim has been satisfied or honestly bounded; every conceivable deeper or denser calculation is not automatically a prerequisite.
claim_specific_stopping_rule.extra_compute_after_closure: May continue as explicitly labelled robustness, Function Map, or Limit Map evidence and may reopen interpretation if it reveals a material contradiction.

independence_rule.question: Could shared information on the specific evidentiary pathway force the agreement being presented?
